# Bunscoill Ghaelgagh

Manx-medium primary school in the Isle of Man.

## Contact & Location
The school is located on Main Rd, St Johns, Isle of Man.
- Telephone: 803330
- Email: BunscoillEnquiries@sch.im

## Educational Focus
The school promotes Manx language learning for families. The school invites parents to learn Manx: "By vie lhiat gysagh Gaelg? Would you like to learn some Manx?"

## Community Engagement
The institution maintains an active social media presence on Facebook and publishes regular blog content about school activities and language instruction.

## Historical Context
Bunscoill Ghaelgagh is the only Manx-medium primary school in the world, enabling approximately 170 children to become fluent Manx speakers. The school follows the same curriculum as other Isle of Man schools but delivers it through the medium of Manx.
